title: FZ-VLM: A Two Stage Florence-Zephyr Vision Language Model Framework for Pulmonary Nodule Characterization and Clinical Decision Making
summary: Lung cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide, and Computed Tomography (CT) is a primary imaging tool for screening and followup assessment. After pulmonary nodule detection, radiologists manually assess anatomical location, diameter, margin characteristics, and attenuation type to support risk assessment and clinical decision-making. However, this post-detection workflow is time-consuming and can be affected by inter-observer variability. Existing Artificial Intelligence methods often focus on isolated tasks, limiting their use as a unified, clinically grounded interpretation framework. This study presents FZ-VLM, a two-stage Florence-Zephyr Vision Language Model framework for unified structured pulmonary nodule characterization in lung CT. The framework uses a fine-tuned Florence-2 model to extract radiological attributes from expert-annotated 2D axial CT slices, while a Zephyr-7B model uses these attributes to generate nodule descriptions, follow-up recommendations, and longitudinal analyses. Results showed that the Stage 1 model achieved 77.18\% accuracy for anatomical location, 67.96\% accuracy for margin characteristics, and 79.13\% accuracy for attenuation type, with a Mean Absolute Error of 2.58 mm for diameter estimation, outperforming evaluated GPT-4-based baselines as well as the human baseline. Expert radiologist evaluation of Stage 2 showed 93.9\% accuracy, 98.6\% completeness score, 76.1\% clinical relevance, and an overall score of 89.5\%. Safety analysis showed that most outputs were clinically safe, although some follow-up recommendations still required expert review. To the best of our knowledge, this study presents the first two-stage Vision-Language Model framework for structured nodule characterization and clinical decision-making.
tldr: FZ-VLM is a two-stage vision-language model framework that uses Florence-2 to extract radiological attributes from lung CT slices and Zephyr-7B to generate nodule descriptions and clinical recommendations, outperforming GPT-4 and human baselines in pulmonary nodule characterization.
tldr_zh: FZ-VLM是一个两阶段视觉语言模型框架，利用Florence-2从肺CT切片提取放射学特征，并通过Zephyr-7B生成结节描述和临床建议，在肺结节表征上优于GPT-4和人类基线。
summary_zh: 肺癌仍是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一，计算机断层扫描（CT）是筛查和随访评估的主要影像工具。在肺结节检测后，放射科医生需手动评估解剖位置、直径、边缘特征及衰减类型，以支持风险分层和临床决策。然而，这一检测后工作流程耗时较长，且可能受观察者间差异影响。现有人工智能方法通常聚焦于孤立任务，限制了其作为统一、临床可解释框架的应用。本研究提出FZ-VLM——一种用于肺CT中统一结构化肺结节表征的两阶段Florence-Zephyr视觉语言模型框架。该框架利用微调的Florence-2模型从专家标注的二维横轴位CT切片中提取放射学属性，同时通过Zephyr-7B模型利用这些属性生成结节描述、随访建议及纵向分析。结果显示：第一阶段模型在解剖位置、边缘特征和衰减类型的准确率分别达到77.18%、67.96%和79.13%，直径估计的平均绝对误差为2.58毫米，优于基于GPT-4的基线模型及人工基准。第二阶段经放射科专家评估，准确率为93.9%，完整度评分为98.6%，临床相关性为76.1%，总体评分为89.5%。安全性分析表明，大多数输出结果在临床上是安全的，但部分随访建议仍需专家复核。据我们所知，本研究首次提出用于结构化结节表征与临床决策的两阶段视觉语言模型框架。

title: Zero-Shot Adaptation of Medical Vision Foundation Models for High-Frequency Micro-Ultrasound Prostate Segmentation
summary:
Prostate cancer claims a life every 80 seconds. Early detection is needed to prevent disease progression, and both PSA density calculation and biopsy decisions rely on knowing the exact boundary of the gland. Conventional ultrasound at 6-12 MHz blurs this boundary, missing one in three high-risk cancers. Micro-ultrasound (29 MHz) improves resolution threefold but introduces dense acoustic speckle that obscures the outer wall; given the same image, two clinicians draw outlines differing by over 10% in area. Supervised methods are costly and generalise poorly across scanners. Can a foundation model segment the prostate with no training data?
  We present the first zero-shot pipeline for this modality: MedSAM, pre-trained on over 1.5 million medical images, localises the prostate; we then apply CLAHE to sharpen the outer wall, binary dilation to recover missed pixels, and Fourier smoothing (4 modes, s=1.05) to refine the boundary. MedSAM requires a spatial prompt, so we evaluate bounding-box and point-click strategies across 75 patients of the Micro-Ultrasound Prostate Segmentation dataset (2,621 slices).
  On the 20-patient held-out test set, the pipeline reduces mean boundary-distance error by 45% (Dice 0.749+/-0.043 to 0.865+/-0.029; HD95 217.2+/-36.9 to 120.1+/-26.1 px), reaching Dice 0.859 across the cohort. Its mean overlap shows no significant difference from the three non-expert rater groups (p>0.19), while segmenting 38-52% more consistently (lower inter-patient standard deviation). Point-click prompts fail regardless of placement (best Dice=0.350), because speckle gives no stable local contrast. Only an approximate bounding box is required, so any clinic can deploy it without data collection, annotation, or retraining.
tldr: Paper presents a zero-shot pipeline using MedSAM with CLAHE, dilation, and Fourier smoothing for micro-ultrasound prostate segmentation, achieving Dice 0.865 on held-out test set without any training data.
tldr_zh: 论文提出了一种零样本管道，利用MedSAM结合CLAHE、膨胀和傅里叶平滑进行微超声前列腺分割，在测试集上Dice达到0.865，无需训练数据。
summary_zh:
前列腺癌每80秒夺走一条生命。早期检测对于阻止疾病进展至关重要，而PSA密度计算和活检决策均依赖于准确获取腺体边界。传统6-12 MHz超声会使边界模糊，导致三分之一的侵袭性癌被漏诊。微超声（29 MHz）将分辨率提升三倍，但引入密集的声学散斑，遮掩了外壁；面对同一图像，两位临床医师勾画轮廓的面积差异超过10%。监督方法成本高昂且在不同扫描仪间泛化能力差。能否在不使用训练数据的情况下，利用基础模型分割前列腺？
我们首次提出该模态的零样本流程：在超过150万张医学图像上预训练的MedSAM定位前列腺；随后应用CLAHE增强外壁边缘、二值膨胀恢复遗漏像素，以及傅里叶平滑（4模态，s=1.05）优化边界。MedSAM需要空间提示，因此我们评估了基于边界框和点击提示的策略，涵盖微超声前列腺分割数据集的75例患者（2,621张切片）。
在20例患者的保留测试集上，该流程将平均边界距离误差降低45%（Dice从0.749±0.043提升至0.865±0.029；HD95从217.2±36.9像素降至120.1±26.1像素），整个队列的Dice达到0.859。其平均重叠与三组非专家评分者无显著差异（p>0.19），而分割一致性提高38-52%（患者间标准差更低）。点点击提示无论置于何处均失败（最佳Dice=0.350），因为散斑无法提供稳定的局部对比度。只需大致边界框，任何诊所均可部署，无需数据收集、标注或重新训练。

title: ForceU-VLA: A Force-Aware Vision-Language-Action Model for Embodied Ultrasound Scanning
summary: Embodied intelligent ultrasound scanning enables the automation and standardization of the ultrasound examination process by integrating perception, decision-making, and execution capabilities. However, existing methods suffer from loosely coupled modeling between force and ultrasound modalities and lack awareness of scanning stages, which limits their ability to capture dynamic probe-tissue interactions. To address these issues, we propose ForceU-VLA, a force-aware Vision-Language-Action model for autonomous embodied ultrasound scanning, which leverages force signals and ultrasound image feedback throughout the scanning process to enable accurate and high-quality ultrasound acquisition. Firstly, we propose a Force-Ultrasound Synergistic Fusion Module (FUSFM) that synergistically fuses ultrasound visual and force-feedback information to provide stable, reliable guidance for probe motion. Secondly, a Stage-Adaptive Modulation Mechanism (SAMM) is proposed to accommodate the task requirements across different scanning stages by adaptively modulating multimodal features to enhance their representation quality. Additionally, we introduce ForceU-VLA-Data, a real-world, force-aware embodied ultrasound dataset that integrates visual, force, and action signals, including data from two organs across five representative clinical scanning views, and comprising 450 expert-collected trajectories with approximately 100,000 synchronized multimodal frames. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that ForceU-VLA significantly improves contact stability and probe pressure regulation in embodied ultrasound scanning, thereby effectively enhancing task execution quality and overall system reliability. The source code is available at https://github.com/VMVLab/ForceU-VLA.
tldr: ForceU-VLA proposes a force-aware Vision-Language-Action model for autonomous ultrasound scanning, integrating force and ultrasound signals via a synergistic fusion module and stage-adaptive modulation to improve contact stability and pressure regulation.
tldr_zh: ForceU-VLA提出了一种力感知的视觉-语言-动作模型用于自主超声扫描，通过协同融合模块和阶段自适应调制集成力与超声信号，以提高接触稳定性和压力调节。
summary_zh: 具身智能超声扫描通过整合感知、决策和执行能力，实现了超声检查过程的自动化和标准化。然而，现有方法在力与超声模态之间建模松散耦合，且缺乏对扫描阶段的感知，这限制了其捕捉动态探头-组织交互的能力。为解决这些问题，我们提出了ForceU-VLA——一种力感知的视觉-语言-动作模型，用于自主具身超声扫描。该模型在整个扫描过程中利用力信号和超声图像反馈，实现准确、高质量的超声采集。首先，我们提出了力-超声协同融合模块（FUSFM），它将超声视觉和力反馈信息协同融合，为探头运动提供稳定、可靠的引导。其次，我们提出了阶段自适应调制机制（SAMM），通过自适应地调制多模态特征以增强其表示质量，从而适应不同扫描阶段的任务需求。此外，我们引入了ForceU-VLA-Data，这是一个真实世界的、力感知的具身超声数据集，集成了视觉、力和动作信号，包含来自两种器官的五个代表性临床扫描视角的数据，由450条专家采集的轨迹组成，约100,000个同步多模态帧。大量实验结果表明，ForceU-VLA在具身超声扫描中显著改善了接触稳定性和探头压力调节，从而有效提升了任务执行质量和系统整体可靠性。源代码可在 https://github.com/VMVLab/ForceU-VLA 获取。

title: SAGE-OR: Semi-supervised Adaptive Scene Graph Generation for Operating Rooms
summary: Current surgical scene graph generation methods depend on dense multi-modal supervision and specialized hardware (synchronized RGB-D sensors, calibration rigs), making dataset construction expensive and restricting all existing benchmarks to simulated environments. We propose SAGE-OR, a feature-centric framework that replaces the traditional detect-then-reason paradigm with a decoupled representation-reasoning paradigm in which localization is derived from frozen foundation models, encoded implicitly in pre-computed features, and used without any localization supervision, while a lightweight graph transformer performs relational reasoning over cached features. We employ a semi-supervised formulation with general-purpose segmentation prompts to eliminate localization supervision while enabling unsupervised context augmentation through additional prompt-driven entities, such as hands, which are absent from annotations. General-purpose prompts are used to induce near-perfect recall, while precision is delegated to downstream attention-based reasoning, enabling simple adaptation to new entities via prompt-level modification. This design enables a lightweight 15M-parameter graph transformer that trains in 1.4 hours and runs relational inference at $\sim$1ms per frame with peak memory under 2GB, suitable for edge hardware used in the operating room; feature extraction runs offline as a separate caching stage (4.27s per frame). On the 4D-OR benchmark, the core model achieves 76% F1, matching the fully supervised 4D-OR baseline while eliminating all localization annotations, and unsupervised hand augmentation raises this to 86%, within 4 points of state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods requiring dense multi-modal supervision, providing a practical pathway for adaptation to new surgical settings without annotation other than relationship and class labels.
tldr: SAGE-OR introduces a semi-supervised, feature-centric framework for surgical scene graph generation that eliminates the need for localization supervision by using frozen foundation models and a lightweight graph transformer, achieving performance comparable to fully supervised methods while enabling easy adaptation to new surgical settings.
tldr_zh: SAGE-OR 提出了一种半监督、以特征为中心的手术场景图生成框架，通过使用冻结的基础模型和轻量级图转换器消除对定位监督的需求，在性能上与全监督方法相当，同时能够轻松适应新的手术环境。
summary_zh: 摘要：当前的手术场景图生成方法依赖于密集的多模态监督和专用硬件（同步RGB-D传感器、校准装置），导致数据集构建成本高昂，且所有现有基准测试均局限于模拟环境。我们提出SAGE-OR，一种以特征为中心的框架，用解耦的表示-推理范式替代传统的检测-推理范式。在该范式中，定位信息源自冻结的基础模型，隐式编码于预计算特征中，且无需任何定位监督即可使用；同时，轻量级图变换器对缓存的特征进行关系推理。我们采用半监督方案，结合通用分割提示以消除定位监督，同时通过额外的提示驱动实体（如注释中缺失的手部）实现无监督上下文增强。通用提示用于诱导近乎完美的召回率，而精确度则交由下游基于注意力的推理处理，从而通过提示级别的修改即可简单适应新实体。该设计使得轻量级（1500万参数）图变换器仅需1.4小时训练，以每帧约1毫秒的速度执行关系推理，峰值内存低于2GB，适用于手术室中使用的边缘硬件；特征提取作为独立的缓存阶段离线运行（每帧4.27秒）。在4D-OR基准测试中，核心模型达到76%的F1分数，与完全监督的4D-OR基线持平，同时消除了所有定位注释；无监督手部增强将该指标提升至86%，与需要密集多模态监督的最先进方法相差仅4个百分点，为无需除关系标签和类别标签外的任何注释即可适应新手术场景提供了实用路径。

title: Real-time Estimator of Actuator Control and Health (REACH) on an Eel-Inspired Soft Robot
summary: An actuator health estimation algorithm for a soft swimming robot that can perform anguilliform swimming is developed. Due to harsh operational environments of underwater robots, and the common degradation of soft robot materials and actuators, accurate estimation of actuator functionality is necessary for robots to perform their missions as well as return to base in the event of actuator degradation and failure. Termed REACH (Real-time Estimator of Actuator Control and Health), the architecture employs a soft robot model, sigma point filter, and a formal statistical hypothesis test to adequately capture the nonlinearities and changes over time. The performance of REACH using three sensor types (GPS, IMU, and Bend Sensor) with one sensor on each actuator is compared, demonstrating that both bend sensor and IMU are adequate choices. Sensor quantity and placement are evaluated for IMU and bend sensor, showing two sensors are sufficient for IMU, whereas three sensors are needed for bend sensor. Three swimming gaits (linear swimming, wide turning, tight turning) are compared, demonstrating that REACH can successfully predict actuator health for all three gaits, with minimal differences in performance. A filter validation method shows the fault estimation algorithm is statistically consistent in finding the correct degradation. The approach is experimentally evaluated using bend sensor data collected from a fish robot, demonstrating that REACH can successfully estimate actuator health with noisy data and variations in manufacturing.
tldr: The paper presents REACH, a real-time actuator health estimation algorithm for eel-inspired soft robots, using a sigma point filter and statistical hypothesis test, evaluated with different sensor types and swimming gaits.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了REACH，一种用于鳗鱼仿生软体机器人的执行器健康实时估计算法，采用sigma点滤波器和统计假设检验，并通过不同传感器和游动步态进行了评估。
summary_zh: 一种针对能够进行鳗鲡式游动的软体游泳机器人的执行器健康估计算法被开发出来。由于水下机器人恶劣的操作环境，以及软体机器人材料和执行器的常见退化，准确估计执行器功能对于机器人完成任务以及在执行器退化和失效时返回基地至关重要。该架构称为REACH（执行器控制与健康实时估计器），采用软体机器人模型、sigma点滤波器和正式的统计假设检验，以充分捕捉非线性特征和随时间的变化。比较了REACH使用三种传感器类型（GPS、IMU和弯曲传感器）且每个执行器配备一个传感器的性能，结果表明弯曲传感器和IMU都是合适的选择。针对IMU和弯曲传感器评估了传感器数量和布置，发现IMU需要两个传感器即足够，而弯曲传感器则需要三个传感器。比较了三种游泳步态（直线游动、大转弯、紧转弯），结果表明REACH能够成功预测所有三种步态下的执行器健康状态，且性能差异极小。一种滤波器验证方法表明，该故障估计算法在找到正确退化程度时具有统计一致性。该方法利用从鱼类机器人收集的弯曲传感器数据进行了实验评估，结果表明REACH能够在存在噪声数据和制造差异的情况下成功估计执行器健康状态。

title: Modeling and Control of an Eel-Inspired Soft Robot for Design Optimization
summary: Anguilliform locomotion is a highly efficient swimming mode; the advent of new materials for soft robots enables the development of an eel-inspired soft robot. This paper presents a simulation model of an eel-inspired soft robot designed for anguilliform swimming. This model can aid in design optimization and the development of model-based estimation, reasoning, and control systems. A Finite Element Method (FEM) model of an elastic rod is used to capture the soft materials of the robotic fish, which makes it particularly amenable to variation over time as the material properties change. The material model is coupled with a hydrodynamic force model to simulate the behavior of a soft, elongated robot in water. The model is used to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control approaches in achieving desired swimming behaviors. It also provides insights into design decisions, including the robustness of different system configurations and the impact of material degradation and failure. The results show that slightly asymmetric designs are advantageous, offering comparable swimming velocities but greater maneuverability. This model can be used to guide future robotic design decisions aimed at optimizing performance for specific tasks.
tldr: This paper presents a simulation model of an eel-inspired soft robot using FEM for the elastic structure and a hydrodynamic force model, demonstrating control approaches and design insights such as the advantage of slightly asymmetric designs for maneuverability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于有限元方法和水动力学模型的鳗鱼仿生软体机器人仿真模型，展示了控制方法及设计见解，如轻微不对称设计在机动性方面的优势。
summary_zh: 鳗鲡式运动是一种高效的游泳模式；软体机器人新材料的出现使得开发仿鳗鱼软体机器人成为可能。本文提出了一种专为鳗鲡式游泳设计的仿鳗鱼软体机器人的仿真模型。该模型有助于设计优化，以及基于模型的估计、推理与控制系统的开发。采用弹性杆的有限元模型来捕捉机器鱼的软材料特性，这使得模型特别适用于随材料性质变化而随时间调整的情况。该材料模型与水动力模型耦合，以模拟细长软体机器人在水中的行为。利用该模型展示了所提出的控制方法在实现期望游泳行为方面的有效性。同时，该模型还为设计决策提供了见解，包括不同系统配置的鲁棒性以及材料退化与失效的影响。结果表明，轻微非对称设计具有优势，能够提供相近的游泳速度但更高的机动性。该模型可用于指导未来以特定任务性能优化为目标的机器人设计决策。

title: Prompting is not enough: supervised baselines and leakage control for measuring shared decision-making with LLMs in pediatric encounters
summary:
Objectives: To determine whether zero-shot prompting of a large language model (LLM) is sufficient to detect shared decision-making (SDM) behaviors in real clinical encounters, and whether supervised learning adds value under patient-grouped, nested evaluation.
  Methods: We analyzed 21 audio-recorded outpatient surgical decision encounters (19 unique patients; 7,566 utterance segments; ~6.1 hours) between families of children with multiple long-term conditions and their surgical providers. Trained coders labeled segments for 12 SDM behaviors (human-human macro Cohen's kappa = 0.695). We compared a zero-shot local LLM (Qwen 2.5 32B), a supervised classifier over frozen sentence embeddings, and their logistic stack, under patient-grouped outer folds with inner cross-fitted thresholds and patient-resampled confidence intervals.
  Results: The zero-shot LLM reached macro kappa = 0.139 (95% CI 0.111-0.164). The supervised classifier reached kappa = 0.227 (0.186-0.262), a paired improvement of 0.088 (0.051-0.119). A logistic stack of the two reached kappa = 0.242 (0.198-0.284). We identified multiple corpus-specific leakage paths, including grouping sibling recordings separately and allowing labels from an outer held-out patient to enter few-shot exemplars used while fitting downstream models.
  Conclusion: Zero-shot prompting alone is not sufficient to measure SDM behavior as reliably as a small supervised model, and patient-level grouping alone does not prevent leakage when labeled prompt exemplars are precomputed outside the outer evaluation loop. Reported performance is sensitive to the unit of data splitting and to where labeled exemplars enter the pipeline. External validation is needed before these findings generalize beyond this population, model, prompt, and codebook.
tldr: This paper demonstrates that zero-shot prompting of an LLM is insufficient for reliably detecting shared decision-making behaviors in pediatric encounters; a small supervised classifier significantly outperforms it, and several data leakage paths are identified that affect performance evaluation.
tldr_zh: 本文表明，零样本提示的LLM不足以可靠地检测儿科问诊中的共享决策行为；一个小型监督分类器显著优于它，并识别出影响性能评估的多种数据泄露路径。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
目的：探究大规模语言模型（LLM）的零样本提示是否足以识别真实临床诊疗中的共享决策（SDM）行为，以及在患者分组、嵌套评估条件下，监督学习是否能带来额外价值。  
方法：我们分析了21段儿童多重长期疾病家庭与其外科医生之间的门诊手术决策录音（涉及19名独立患者；7566个话语片段；约6.1小时）。经培训的编码员对12种SDM行为进行片段标注（人-人宏观Cohen's kappa = 0.695）。我们比较了零样本本地LLM（Qwen 2.5 32B）、基于固定句子嵌入的监督分类器及其逻辑堆叠模型，评估采用患者分组的外层折叠、内部交叉拟合阈值以及患者重采样的置信区间。  
结果：零样本LLM的宏观kappa为0.139（95% CI 0.111–0.164）。监督分类器的kappa为0.227（0.186–0.262），成对改进值为0.088（0.051–0.119）。两者逻辑堆叠的kappa为0.242（0.198–0.284）。我们识别出多种语料库特有的泄露路径，包括将兄弟姐妹的录音单独分组，以及允许来自外层搁置患者的标签进入下游模型拟合时使用的少量样本示例。  
结论：仅凭零样本提示无法像小型监督模型那样可靠地测量SDM行为；当标注的提示示例在外层评估循环之外预先计算时，仅患者层级的分组无法防止泄露。报告的性能对数据分割单元以及标注示例进入流程的位置敏感。在将这些发现推广到本研究人群、模型、提示和编码手册之外之前，需要进行外部验证。
